dict.string: MABEL uses Bluetooth to find your robot when you are near it and to drive it directly — so teleoperation keeps working with no Wi-Fi and no internet.
MABEL uses hand tracking to teleoperate the robot's arms and fingers.
MABEL connects to the robot controller on your local Wi-Fi network for live video and telemetry.
MABEL uses the microphone so you can talk to the robot — dictate commands and chat with it hands-free.
MABEL transcribes your speech on-device so you can command and chat with the robot by voice.
MABEL uses world sensing to track your head position for robot camera alignment.
